paragraphs.text: 114 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War

Halcyon solidifies its position as capital of the Thran Empire . The Thran Civil War breaks out - a power struggle between the elite imperialists and republican commoners, with the artificers on the side of the elite and the eugenicists on that of the republicans.
49 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War
43 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War
14 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War
The Halcyon elite stamps out the last bits of republican resistance. All the eugenicists are exiled, and the Thran Civil War officially ends.
9 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War
Glacian is stabbed by Gix using a powerstone during an Untouchable riot and is afflicted with phthisis .
8 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War

Yawgmoth is recalled from exile by Rebbec to cure Glacian. He discovers that phthisis is caused by powerstone radiation, and that the Untouchables have caught it en masse because their caves lie under the Mana Rig that makes the stones. He also notes that the Halcytes themselves are also starting to get infected.
7 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War

Gix leads the first Untouchables' uprising to take vengeance on the people who afflicted them with phthisis. Jonas is killed. Yawgmoth discovers a serum that slows the disease down and uses it to quell the rebellion.
4 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War
A planeswalker named Dyfed appears before Yawgmoth and shows him the plane of Pyrulea .
3 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War

Gix leads the second rebellion of Untouchables. This allows Yawgmoth to claim emergency power over the entire defense of Halcyon and stops the rebellion once more, this time forcing Gix into his personal service.
2 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War

Months later, after the city is rebuilt, the Thran Alliance sends delegates to Halcyon. Dwarves , elves , minotaurs , viashino , cat people , and barbarians reveal that their countries have all been ravaged by Yawgmoth and his eugenicist followers during their exile. The Alliance tells Halcyon to rid Yawgmoth of his privileges, or they will declare war. The council decides Yawgmoth can stay, but with 15 against 13 votes, with the two deciding votes being those of Rebbec and Yawgmoth himself. Yawgmoth overthrows the Elder Council and starts to prepare for war.
Dyfed takes the imprisoned Thran Elder Council along with a host of Glacian's goblins to the plane of Mercadia .
Yawgmoth is shown Phyrexia by Dyfed, who opens a stable portal between that plane and Dominaria.
Orleason and Phoenon are taken by the Thran Alliance
Phoenon and its air fleet is destroyed by Yawgmoth
The Battle of the Null Sphere - Yawgmoth claims the Null Sphere , lifting it into the air with a powerstone equator.
The Battle of Megheddon Defile - Yawgmoth obliterates the Megheddon Defile and the Thran Alliance's ground troops.

The Battle of Halcyon - The Null Moon is brought into orbit. Yawgmoth defeats the Thran Alliance, wipes out all Thran cities, and claims most of the population of Halcyon into Phyrexia, but Rebbec closes the portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia with Yawgmoth and his followers are trapped on the other side.
